settings.visualStyle: Grounded cinematic first-person realism during the Second Battle of El Alamein. British Eighth Army POV, moonlit desert, marked minefield lanes, sand texture, heat and cold contrast, dust, engines, distant artillery and human fatigue. Avoid constant rifle-centered framing and action-game pacing.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds. No dialogue, no narrator, no intelligible speech. The POV remains British Eighth Army / Allied for the whole episode. Nearby friendlies remain historically appropriate Allied desert forces; German/Italian Axis personnel appear only as a clearly separated opposing force. Weapon state varies naturally between ready, lowered, slung, resting, partial-frame and off-frame. Include environmental exploration, careful ground inspection, quiet recovery, scale reveals and short bursts of danger.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person desert warfare reenactment with cinematic timing, realistic body weight, windblown sand, heat haze, night-to-dawn light change and physically believable movement.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP03 — El Alamein: Through the Devil's Gardens
movie.storySummary: A fictional British Eighth Army infantry soldier moves through the minefield belts and desert battle of El Alamein, experiencing long pauses, careful navigation, dust, thirst and the eventual breakthrough west.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Make the viewer feel physically present in the El Alamein desert. Use contrast between vast silence and sudden artillery, careful minefield movement and brief exposed dashes, hot daylight and cold night. Do not keep the rifle centered in every shot. Let the soldier inspect tape markers, footprints, vehicle tracks, maps and distant horizons with the weapon slung or out of frame. Nearby friendlies are Allied; Axis forces, if visible, remain clearly separated beyond opposing positions. No dialogue or narration.

scenes.title: Before the Guns
scenes.description: A low, tense opening in a night trench.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier sits low and rubs sand from his hands while the Lee-Enfield rests against the trench wall.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person seated trench view, dusty British sleeves, hands brushing sand, rifle resting off to one side, moonlit desert lip, artillery batteries faint behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still low POV. Audio: desert wind, fabric, distant engines, breath, occasional metal clink. No nearby firing.

scenes.title: The Barrage
scenes.description: The horizon suddenly erupts with the opening bombardment.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier rises just enough to see the artillery flashes stretch across the horizon.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view over trench edge, broad line of distant British artillery flashes and dust columns, hands on earth, weapon not visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow rise from trench darkness into a wide cinematic horizon reveal. Audio expands from wind to rolling artillery thunder and sand vibration.

scenes.title: Step Into the Desert
scenes.description: The infantry begins the night advance.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier climbs out, rifle slung, and follows Allied silhouettes across moonlit sand.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person walking view with British/Allied infantry ahead, rifle sling edge only, moonlit sand, artillery glow behind, no Axis troops mixed nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: One continuous climb and forward walk. Audio: boots in sand, web gear, breath, distant barrage.

scenes.title: Read the Tape
scenes.description: A careful ground-level minefield observation scene.
scenes.actionDescription: Kneeling, the soldier touches a taped lane marker and studies disturbed sand and engineer footprints.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person kneeling hands near white tape, boot prints, sand ridges, engineer tools, rifle off-frame, Allied boots ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Start looking down at hands and tape, then slowly track along the lane. Audio: tape flutter, sand, distant guns, slow breathing.

scenes.title: One Step at a Time
scenes.description: The soldier crosses the lane with his eyes on the ground.
scenes.actionDescription: He follows the marked path, rifle lowered at his side and mostly outside the frame.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person downward view of boots inside the taped lane, sand texture and footprints, squadmate feet ahead, no centered weapon.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low walking POV focused on careful foot placement. Audio: sand crunch, tape flutter, breath, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Dust Wave
scenes.description: A short near-miss tension beat without showing injury.
scenes.actionDescription: A distant impact throws a rolling wall of dust across the lane and the soldier drops low.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person low crouch, dust cloud crossing ahead, Allied silhouettes flat to ground, tape visible, no bodies or gore.
scenes.videoPrompt: Fast drop to low position, then hold while dust passes. Audio: distant blast, sand hiss, muffled hearing for a moment, breathing.

scenes.title: First Light
scenes.description: Dawn reveals the scale of the battlefield.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier rises behind a low ridge and shades his eyes with one hand.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hand shielding eyes, vast dawn desert, smoke columns, Allied tanks and infantry far behind/nearby on the friendly side, opposing Axis positions only in the distant frontage.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow upward reveal over ridge to broad battlefield. Weapon absent from frame. Audio: wind, distant engines, guns far away, breath.

scenes.title: Tank Corridor
scenes.description: The soldier watches Allied armor pass through a cleared route.
scenes.actionDescription: He steps aside, lowers the rifle completely out of frame and watches tanks move through dust.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person side view of historically plausible Allied tanks passing at mid-distance, dust rolling over boots, British soldiers crouched nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan following one tank from front quarter to rear dust trail. Audio: engines, tracks, wind, fabric, breath.

scenes.title: Water Break
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier sets the rifle on the ground beside him and drinks from a canteen with both hands.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person seated/kneeling view, dusty hands around metal canteen, Lee-Enfield resting on sand to the side, harsh light and heat haze.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static recovery shot. No nearby combat and no music. Audio: canteen cap, swallow, wind, slow breath, distant engine hum.

scenes.title: Tracks in the Sand
scenes.description: The soldier explores vehicle and boot tracks beyond a ridge.
scenes.actionDescription: Walking slowly with rifle slung, he kneels to inspect deep track marks and churned sand.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hand touching tank track impression, dust on glove, abandoned sandbag fragment nearby, weapon off-frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow walk, kneel, close look at ground texture. Audio: sand, wind, fabric, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Renewed Push
scenes.description: A sudden movement beat as the advance resumes.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier stands quickly, grabs the rifle and moves with Allied infantry into the next sector.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person quick rise from sand, rifle entering frame from the side, Allied troops moving ahead through churned desert.
scenes.videoPrompt: Fast stand and short forward movement after the quiet scene. Audio: gear snap, boots, engines, distant artillery, faster breath.

scenes.title: Abandoned Position
scenes.description: The soldier explores an evacuated Axis defensive position after the line breaks.
scenes.actionDescription: With rifle lowered, he steps through empty sandbags and looks at discarded equipment without touching it.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person slow walk through empty opposing trench, abandoned Axis equipment spatially separate from Allied troops entering behind, no enemy mixed in the friendly group.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow cautious walkthrough at chest height, brief downward glance at objects, then horizon. Audio: canvas flap, sand, wind, distant engines.

scenes.title: Road West
scenes.description: A cinematic long-distance observation of withdrawing Axis traffic.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier raises binoculars while the rifle hangs slung across his back.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person binocular view of distant Axis vehicle columns withdrawing west, heat haze and dust; no nearby enemy troops among Allied positions.
scenes.videoPrompt: One binocular raise and steady hold. Audio: wind, binocular handling, distant engines, breath.

scenes.title: Open Desert
scenes.description: The soldier walks beyond the former defensive belt.
scenes.actionDescription: He walks with the rifle slung, one hand adjusting a dusty strap while Allied vehicles pass farther away.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person open desert, one dusty hand adjusting webbing, rifle mostly off-frame, Allied columns moving west, cleared lane markers behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady fatigued walk with a side glance toward moving vehicles. Audio: wind, boots, engines, fabric, breath.

scenes.title: End of the Beginning
scenes.description: The episode ends with a quiet wide desert view after the breakthrough.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier stops, rests a hand on his hip and watches the column stretch west under the huge sky.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wide late-day desert, Allied column receding into dust, no weapon visible, long shadows and open horizon.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow stop and wide hold. Audio: wind, distant engines, tired breathing; no triumphal music and no speech.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.role: Fictional composite British Eighth Army infantry soldier
characters.description: Anonymous British/Allied first-person soldier at El Alamein, historically plausible 1942 desert uniform and Lee-Enfield rifle.
characters.mainOutfit: Khaki desert uniform, web equipment, steel helmet, boots, Lee-Enfield rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Nearby friendlies remain British/Allied desert forces. Axis personnel/equipment remain clearly opposing and spatially separate. Keep dust, sweat, thirst and gear continuity. Weapon state varies naturally by scene.

atmosphereAssets.description: Allied night desert trenches and artillery positions before attack.

atmosphereAssets.title: Minefield and Forward Positions
atmosphereAssets.description: Marked lanes, disturbed sand, Allied cleared corridors, ridges, smoke and distant opposing Axis frontage.

atmosphereAssets.title: Western Desert Beyond the Line
atmosphereAssets.description: Open desert and advancing Allied columns after the breakthrough.
